from pathlib import Path
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
import os,json
path=Path(r"C:\Users\jillv\source\ReleaseLens\releaselens\docs\review\challenge-dev-packet.html")
with sync_playwright() as p:
 browser=p.chromium.launch(channel="msedge",headless=True)
 page=browser.new_page(viewport={"width":1280,"height":900})
 errors=[]
 page.on("pageerror",lambda e:errors.append(str(e)))
 page.goto(path.as_uri())
 assert page.title()=="ReleaseLens independent source review"
 assert page.locator("article").count()==12
 assert page.locator("script").count()==0
 count=page.locator("details").count()
 page.locator("details summary").first.click()
 assert page.locator("details").first.get_attribute("open") is not None
 assert not errors,errors
 out=Path(os.environ["TEMP"])/"releaselens-review-packet.png"
 page.screenshot(path=str(out),full_page=False)
 print(json.dumps({"browser":"Installed Edge, isolated headless context","questions":12,"source_documents":count,"collapsible_sources":"passed","scripts":0,"page_errors":errors,"screenshot":str(out)}))
 browser.close()
